name: Salutica Berhad
overview: Salutica 今年提出多元化计划，拟通过私下配售集资并进入物业发展及建筑业务；其全资子公司 SLTC Venture 获得 Puncak Ecocity (Klang) 的翻新与维修工程合约。此外。
overview_en: Salutica proposed a diversification into property development and construction, alongside a private placement to raise funds; its wholly-owned subsidiary SLTC Venture secured a renovation and repair works contract from Puncak Ecocity (Klang). The company also proposed a RM100 million reduction of its issued share capital.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司提出私下配售及业务多元化。
segments.note_en: The company proposed a private placement and business diversification, and proposed a capital reduction.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 包括设计与建造工程、建筑材料贸易与供应，以及物业管理与投资。
actions.text_en: Proposed to diversify existing principal activities into property development, construction and construction-related activities, including design-and-build works, trading and supply of construction materials, and property management and investment.

segments.name: 制造与设计服务
segments.note: 子公司获得翻新与维修工程合约。
segments.note_en: A subsidiary secured a renovation and repair works contract.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 SLTC Venture Sdn Bhd 接受 Puncak Ecocity (Klang) Sdn Bhd 的授标函，承接位于 Selangor 的 Klang 的16个单位三层商铺的翻新与维修工程。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SLTC Venture Sdn Bhd accepted a letter of award from Puncak Ecocity (Klang) Sdn Bhd for the execution and completion of renovation and repair works for 16 units of three-storey shop offices in Klang, Selangor.

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 包括设计与建造、建筑材料贸易及物业管理与投资。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed to diversify into property development, construction and related activities, including design-and-build, trading of construction materials, and property management and investment.
